finalProject.prompt: Explain how Salt-N-Pepa used humor, sexual agency, and catchy hooks to open doors for women in hip-hop. Compare ONE early song (‘Push It’ or ‘Tramp’) with ONE feminist-era anthem (‘Shoop’ or ‘None of Your Business’) and identify TWO modern artists who clearly reflect Salt-N-Pepa’s influence.
